about: Hand-curated venue research for the AIS annual conference, keyed by the code the eventact-agenda adapter gives the host college. Every figure is {value, source}, or null when nobody could cite it; coordinates carry the basis they rest on and their source.

ramat-gan-academic-college.name: Ramat Gan Academic College

coordinates.basis: the article's coordinates on Hebrew Wikipedia

ramat-gan-academic-college.notes: The 2026 host (the conference page and the agenda's own header name it). The agenda runs eleven halls, numbered 1 to 11, which it does not map onto the college's own rooms, so no seat count is served for a hall. The college's own site did not answer when this was researched, so no street address is served.
